summary: Frontend-only mobile UI testing for the offline Machinist Thread Reference Expo app. Exercised all 12 requested flows on mobile viewport (375x667) via web preview. Home → Unified/Metric → list + search/clear → spec → external/internal toggle → class change → tap drill % + cutting/forming → 3-wire calculator + custom wire + use-best-wire → back nav. All flows passed. No backend (offline app, by design).

issues: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — comes from a child component (likely Pressable/Ionicons wrapper). Cosmetic only; safe to ignore but main agent may migrate to style.pointerEvents to silence.

action_items: (Optional) Address React Native Web deprecation warning about props.pointerEvents to keep console clean.
critical_code_review_comments: spec.tsx: 'use best wire' click sets wireInput to fmt(bestW) which formats with 4 decimal places for unified — confirmed populates correctly (e.g., 0.0072). Works as intended.

threads.tsx: FlatList virtualization renders ~10–45 DOM nodes at a time (mobile viewport). Header text correctly shows '<filtered> of <all>' counts; total Unified=56, Metric=full M1–M25 set as specified.

Class 2A label is reused on metric in the UI (per design choice). If strict ISO tolerance class names (6g/6H) are desired in a future iteration, surface them on metric spec page; current implementation is acceptable for this MVP.
All interactive elements have correct testIDs as specified in agent_to_agent_context_note. Touch targets ≥44px verified (segBtn 56px, segBtnSm 48px, pctBtn 48px, list rows 72px).
No raw text outside <Text> components. No HTML elements. All styles via StyleSheet.create.
No business-logic issues observed in calculations (tap drill changes with %, forming vs cutting differ, M-over-wires updates with custom wire).
seed_data_creation: None — fully offline app, no DB/seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully offline (no /api calls). All testIDs verified working: system-select-unified/metric, search-input, clear-search, thread-list-item-{id}, type-external/internal, class-1A/2A/3A/1B/2B/3B, tap-cutting/forming, percent-50..75, tap-drill-result, three-wire-result, wire-input, use-best-wire. Total Unified threads = 56, Metric = M1–M25 set with coarse/fine/super-fine. FlatList is virtualized so query_selector_all yields a partial DOM count — use the visible count text for totals.
